hero.title:
Know where to go,
before you go.
hero.lead: Tell Healix how you feel, in your own language. It finds the right specialist, the right time to leave, and explains your reports gently.

how.title: Six calm steps from worry to clarity.
how.lead: Six small steps, each one explained as it happens.

s1.title: Tell Healix how you feel
s1.body: Type or speak in Hindi, Marathi, English or a mix. Not sure of the words? Tap the body map and the pain scale instead.

s2.title: Watch it think, safely
s2.body: Danger signs are checked first. Then Healix shows every step it took, so you can see why it suggests a specialist and how soon to go.

s3.title: Choose a doctor and a time
s3.body: Pick the specialty, the date and the time you prefer. Compare doctors near you by fee, language and waiting time, then book in one tap.

s4.title: Get your token, leave at the right time
s4.body: Your digital token shows your place in the queue and why the wait changes. Healix tells you when to leave home, and you can ask the person ahead to swap places.

s5.title: Make sense of your reports
s5.body: Upload a photo or PDF. Healix reads it, you confirm the values, and every result is explained against its usual range, with questions to ask your doctor.

s6.title: Ask, and share with others
s6.body: Ask the report assistant about any word you do not understand, or visit the community to read what others with the same condition are asking.

visual.points: Burning after meals points to the stomach
visual.chatAnswer: It is your average blood sugar over about three months.

features.title: Everything a patient worries about, answered.
features.aside: Built for older and long-term patients, and the family members who look after them.

assistant.label: Report assistant
assistant.title: Any doubt about your report, answered in plain words.
assistant.body: Ask what a test means, what a usual range is, or why a value is marked high. The assistant explains the jargon in your report in simple words. It only answers questions about your report, and nothing else.
assistant.a: HbA1c is your average blood sugar over about three months. 7.1% is above the usual range of 4.0 to 5.6%, so your doctor will want to talk about it.
assistant.a2: It is the span of values most healthy people have for that test. A value outside it is not a diagnosis, just a point to discuss with your doctor.
assistant.note: Only answers questions about your report.

symptoms.title: Symptom check
symptoms.body: Say how you feel in your own words. Healix checks danger signs first, shows its reasoning step by step, and points you to the right kind of doctor.

doctors.title: Find and book a doctor
doctors.body: Choose a specialty, a date and a time that suits you. See doctors near you with fees, languages and expected waits, and filter the list.

token.title: Live token and queue
token.body: Get a digital token the moment you book. Watch the queue move, see why the wait changes, and get told when to leave home.

reports.title: Report reader
reports.body: Upload a photo or PDF of a lab report. Healix reads it, you check the values, and every result is explained against its usual range.

community.title: Community
community.body: Read and share experiences with people who live with the same condition. Join topics like diabetes or heart health, post questions and reply, under a nickname.

language.title: Your language, your voice
language.body: Hindi, Marathi, English or Hinglish. Speak your symptoms and have answers read aloud.

family.title: Family profiles
family.body: Add parents or children with their own details. Reports, tokens and bookings stay separate for each person.

elder.title: Large-text mode
elder.body: Bigger text, a simpler home screen and results read aloud, made for older relatives.

emergency.title: Emergency help
emergency.body: One press away on this page. Call 102 or 112, find the nearest emergency department and alert the hospital before you arrive.

hospitals.title: A calmer waiting room.
hospitals.body: Live queues, predicted waits and doctor availability on one screen, so front desks spend less time answering “how long?”.
